$description: Content/licensing policy for generated PageSpecs. Enforced by schema/semantic_validate.py rules REAL_ENTITY_DENYLIST, REAL_COPY_VERBATIM, NO_STORED_BODIES, OUTBOUND_LINK_HOSTS and (generated mode) GENERATED_MODE_BRAND_TERMS / GENERATED_MODE_ASSET_ROLES / GENERATED_MODE_SOURCE_ARTWORK / GENERATED_MODE_REQUIRED_SLOTS.

realCompany.statement: activepieces.com is a real, live commercial site. This design-repo and the clone it describes are a private study artefact. Do not publish either, do not make the repository public, and do not deploy generated pages publicly.

evidence.quote: Source: https://www.activepieces.com/

generatedContentRules: Use synthetic copy shaped to each field's maxWords budget; never reproduce Activepieces' proprietary marketing copy verbatim (fingerprints below).
Never name real customers, real reviewers, real case-study people or real blog authors; never attribute quotes, metrics or claims to them.
Never reproduce real logos or photos of real people: media slots for those roles take placeholder: refs (assets/asset-roles.json pinnedPolicies).
Short UI labels (button and link labels such as 'Start building', 'Talk to sales') are interface strings and may be reused.

Brand: PageSpec.mode 'generated' (a page for another brand) must not carry the Activepieces name, wordmark, logomark, commissioned art, editorial covers, investor badge or any clone file path (GENERATED_MODE_* rules, assets/asset-roles.json availability); bind brand to brand.placeholder / brand.user-supplied and art to art.generic. Mode 'reference' (clone fidelity) may use the real brand.

storedBodies.rule: Blog, resource and legal BODIES are deliberately not stored (metadata only). Each page renders a placeholder body that exercises the prose styles plus a 'Read the full ... on activepieces.com' link. PageSpecs for these templates have no body field (bodyMode const 'placeholder'); generators must not fabricate bodies, least of all attributed to real authors.

evidence.quote: **Content policy.** The clone stores **metadata only**
<ReadFullLink href={post.url}>Read the full article on activepieces.com</ReadFullLink>

noRuntimeExternalRequests.rule: All assets are local under public/ at their original paths. The only external URLs are outbound navigation links. The only runtime fetch is the local /data/pieces/<slug>.json. The /sales form never submits.

evidence.quote: Never reference activepieces.com at runtime.
const p = fetch(`/data/pieces/${slug}.json`)
- The clone does **not** submit.
